body.p: The Non-Final Office Action of November 6, 2024 ("Office Action") has been carefully reviewed and these remarks are responsive thereto. Claims 1-5 and 7-11 are presently amended. Claim 6 has been canceled without prejudice or disclaimer. New claims 12-17 have been added. Claims 1-5 and 7-17 are pending in this application. Reconsideration and allowance of the instant application are respectfully requested.

The drawings are objected to under 37 C.F.R. 1.83(a) because the drawings allegedly do not show every feature of the invention specified in the claims. Specifically, the Office asserts that the claim 3 feature of "an upper center of the fuselage" must be shown or canceled from the claim(s).

Without acquiescing to the propriety of the objection, claim 3 has been amended to change "an upper center of the fuselage" to "a center of the spar cover of the fuselage." One of ordinary skill in the art would have readily understood that at least FIGS. 7 and 8A show such features of present claim 3. For example, the wing frame parts 440 (e.g., a rib) are provided and respectively tilted to away from the center of the spar cover 800. Accordingly, Applicants respectfully request reconsideration and withdrawal of the objection.

The Office has not identified specification objections other than the above-noted drawing objections. As discussed above, the drawing objection has been rendered moot. Accordingly, Applicants respectfully request reconsideration and withdrawal of the objection.

Claims 3 and 11 are objected to because of alleged informalities. Specifically, the Office asserts that the term "to be" is not a positive limitation inasmuch as the term is in future tense and implies a change in condition in the future, and it does not serve to limit the structure in the present tense.

Without acquiescing to the propriety of the objection, claims 3 and 11 have been amended to remove "to be," thereby rendering the objection moot. Accordingly, Applicants respectfully request reconsideration and withdrawal of the objection.

Claims 1-11 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112, as being allegedly indefinite. Without acquiescing to the propriety of the rejection, the claims have been amended, for additional clarity, to recite "wing load support structure of a fuselage," thereby rendering the rejection moot. Applicants respectfully note that one of ordinary skill in the art would have readily understood the present claim language in light of the original specification. Accordingly, Applicants respectfully request reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejection.
Applicants note with appreciation that claims 6-11 contain allowable subject matter.

Claims 1-5 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being allegedly unpatentable over Hasan (US20150041589), in view of Rawdon (US20240253760). Without acquiescing to the propriety of the rejection, claim 1 has been amended to incorporate allowable claim 6 features. Accordingly, present claim 1 is in condition for allowance.
Each of dependent claims 2-5 and 7-11, which ultimately depends from claim 1, is allowable due to its dependency and further in view of the additional features recited therein.

New claim 13 is independent form of allowable claim 9 and addresses the above-discussed objections and 112 rejection. Accordingly, new claim 13 is in condition for allowance. Each of new dependent claims 12 and 14-17, which ultimately depends from claim 1 or claim 13, is allowable due to its dependency and further in view of the additional features recited therein.

All issues having been addressed, Applicants respectfully submit that the instant application is in condition for allowance, and respectfully solicits prompt notification of the same. However, if for any reason the Examiner believes the application is not in condition for allowance or there are any questions, the Examiner is requested to contact the undersigned at (202) 824-3345.

The Director is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees which may be required with respect to this communication, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 19-0733, under Order No. 009489.00187\US.
